{{Quote|It was a few months after the war began. The Republic couldn't stop the droid attack. My husband was killed, our home&mdash;our ''whole village''&mdash;was destroyed.|Crys Taanzer recounts the death of her husband|<ref name="Dark Times" />}}
The '''husband''' of [[Crys Taanzer]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Nadiem/Legends|Nadiem]]. [[Marriage/Legends|Married]] to his wife during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], together they [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] son, [[Kennan Taanzer]]. During the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Nadiem|invasion]] of Nadiem in [[22 BBY/Legends|21.6 BBY]], this person was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and the Taanzer family's village destroyed. Both Crys and Kennan survived, and after [[Unidentified Ho'Din Jedi|a Jedi]] on Nadiem determined that Kennan was [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive, Crys gave Kennan over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]], and to ensure that he made it out of the battle alive.<ref name="Dark Times" />
